Help & policies

Privacy notice

How Retirement Forecast handles your information.

Who operates this planner

Retirement Forecast is operated by Robert Soliday. For questions about this notice or your information, email rtsoliday@gmail.com.

Retirement scenarios stay in your browser

The planner stores your assumptions, budgets, and scenarios in browser local storage and runs calculations on your device. The application does not upload those inputs or simulation results to its hosting service, Google Firebase, or Stripe. Reports and JSON backups are generated locally when you export them.

Anyone with access to the same browser profile may be able to view saved plans. Signing out does not remove them. You control copies you export or share, including any information you choose to email to support.

Sign-in and subscription information

If you sign in with ChatGPT, the hosting service supplies an authenticated account identifier and may supply your email. If you use Google sign-in, Firebase Authentication handles the sign-in session, and the server verifies the resulting identity token, provider, account identifier, and verified email when present. Sign-in providers and your browser use cookies or local storage to maintain sessions.

Verified account identifiers are associated with Stripe customer and subscription records to provide Pro access. If you explicitly link accounts, both identifiers are associated with the same billing customer. Stripe processes payment and billing details; the planner does not receive your full card number. Account verification and subscription checks do not include your retirement assumptions.

The browser also keeps a Stripe customer reference in session storage to restore billing status after checkout or a page reload. This identifier does not contain payment-card details or retirement assumptions and does not grant access by itself; the server verifies account ownership and subscription status.

Hosting and traffic measurement

OpenAI Sites and Cloudflare deliver and protect this website. They may process ordinary request information, such as IP addresses, requested URLs, browser information, timestamps, and diagnostic or security logs. The owner traffic dashboard uses Cloudflare’s aggregate daily page-view and unique-IP counts. It does not include retirement scenarios.

The application does not add advertising trackers or upload scenario data for analytics. The providers’ handling of service data is described in their own notices.

Support, storage, and your choices

If you email support, your email address, message, and any attachments are received to respond to your request. Send only the information needed for help.

Local plans remain until you delete or replace them, or your browser clears them. Export a backup before clearing site data. Clear this site’s browser storage to remove local plans and sign-in state; exported files must be deleted separately. This does not cancel billing or delete provider accounts.

For access, correction, or deletion requests relating to information held by the operator, contact support. Identity verification may be needed. Billing, security, and support records may need to be retained for service, recordkeeping, or legal reasons; provider retention follows their own policies. No fixed deletion period is promised here.

Service providers

Read the OpenAI privacy policy, Cloudflare privacy policy, Firebase privacy information, and Stripe privacy policy for their practices. Google sign-in is optional; payment services are used when you subscribe or manage billing.
